tools.name: find_videos
tools.title: Find Videos
tools.description: Use this when the user wants example videos: the most viral videos on a topic, what is working in a niche, or videos matching a look ("faceless", "talking head", "UGC"), platform, dates, creator size, views, region or language. Returns up to 25 videos a page with links, creator, stats, Virality Score and Data Intelligence. Searches what Virlo has already analysed, the user's research, or one agent. Put every filter in this one call: each call draws its own card. Cost: $0.05 per library page of 25, nothing for an empty page; free for the user's own research. Instant.

topics.description: What the content is about, in the words the user said, main topic first.

tools.name: get_topic_trends
tools.title: Topic Trends
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what news or pop culture topics people are talking about. view today is today's topics, emerging is what is heating up by momentum, range is a date range by region. category keeps only some categories and exclude_category leaves some out. Topics, not video formats. Cost: $0.25. Instant.

tools.name: list_my_research
tools.title: List My Research
tools.description: Use this when the user refers to their earlier work: a research agent by topic, a creator lookup they ran, or who they track. kind agents (default) finds agents, q narrows by name or topic. Returns short entries with ids. Cost: free. Instant.

tools.name: create_research_agent
tools.title: Create Research Agent
tools.description: Use this when find_videos comes back thin, the user wants fresh data collected on a topic, or wants a niche kept up to date. A research agent is Virlo going out to collect fresh videos across TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, then writing a report on what works. recurring true keeps running on a schedule. Call without user_approved to get a proposal, explain it in plain words, and wait. Set user_approved to true only after the user says yes to it. Cost: $0.50 a run, $1.50 with Data Intelligence; a recurring agent charges every run. Async: about 8 minutes.

tools.name: get_agent_report
tools.title: Agent Report
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a research agent's results in one answer: what's working in the niche, the top videos, hooks, trends, rising creators and sounds. Cost: free. Instant.

tools.name: get_agent_data
tools.title: Agent Data
tools.description: Use this when the user wants more than an agent's report: its videos, slideshows, ads, top creators, analysis, trends, sounds, hashtags, hooks. Filter and sort with the options. Cost: free, except hooks at $0.25 when the agent has no Data Intelligence. Instant.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.title: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how much balance or how many credits they have left, or what a call cost. Returns balance in dollars, credits_remaining, status and a pricing quick-reference map (1 credit = $0.01). Cost: free. Instant.
